holderQuote: Even the spells I know are things I had to learn, not things that were given to me.
The Human, Ryoka Griffin, stood alone in a circle of Goblins.
effectQuote: A beam of light burst from her finger, catching the Goblins by surprise.

holderQuote: I raise my finger and point it at the faerie.
effectQuote: the world around me lights up, and the faerie shouts in surprise

holderQuote: I had no idea I could do it, but while I was in the cave I started experimenting with the two spells I did know.
effectQuote: works well enough just to blind people

holderQuote: I whisper to myself as I point a finger at my leg.
effectQuote: The tip of my finger is glowing white-yellow, and it’s emitting a cone of light that looks like any flashlight beam.

holderQuote: My palm shines white, and the Drakes and Gnolls cry out and cover their eyes.
effectQuote: My palm shines white, and the Drakes and Gnolls cry out and cover their eyes.

holderQuote: All her amazing magical powers like casting uh, [Flashlight]. Ryoka Griffin knew that he knew what it was.
